name: Shishidou Chiharu Flamsteed
original_name: 獅子堂・千晴・フラムスティード
source:
Bodyguard and childhood friend of Rena, somewhat overprotective. She is involved in security of Oukou Gakuen and Ootori gallery too.

Her mother is English and so has blond hair, so that she is often mistaken as foreigner, but she doesn't like that. She spent most of time in Japan and loves Japanese culture.
